QUEENMOD2-SWARM.title: Swarm
QUEENMOD2-SWARM.description: Deals damage to enemies and grants Block to allies. Moves to enemies you target and returns to you when you block. Reduced by 1 at the end of the turn.
QUEENMOD2-SWARM.smartDescription: {OnPlayer:At the end of the turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block. Moves to enemies you target and returns to you when you Block.|At the end of the turn, take [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage. Moves to enemies you target and returns to you when you Block.} Reduced by 1 at end of turn.
QUEENMOD2-POLLINATED.title: Pollinated
QUEENMOD2-POLLINATED.description: When target is hit, increase by 1. When target has 5 Pollinated, add 2 Honeycombs to your Hand which gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and remove this.
QUEENMOD2-POLLINATED.smartDescription: When target is hit, increase by 1. When target has 5 Pollinated, and add 2 [gold]Honeycombs[/gold] to your hand which gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and remove this.
QUEENMOD2-WAX_JAVELIN_POWER.title: Wax Armorers
QUEENMOD2-WAX_JAVELIN_POWER.description: When you Exhaust a Honeycomb, add a Javelin to your hand which deals damage.
QUEENMOD2-WAX_JAVELIN_POWER.smartDescrip: When you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Honeycomb[/gold], add a [gold]Wax Javelin[/gold] to your hand which deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage.
QUEENMOD2-PHEREMONE.title: Pheromones
QUEENMOD2-PHEREMONE.description: Swarm will stay on to targets with pheromones. Increases Swarm Block and Damage. Reduced by 2 at the end of the turn.
QUEENMOD2-PHEREMONE.smartDescription: [gold]Swarm[/gold] will stay on to targets with [gold]Pheromones[/gold]. Increases [gold]Swarm[/gold] Block and Damage. Reduced by 2 at the end of the turn.
QUEENMOD2-FORCED_MARCH_POWER.title: Forced March
QUEENMOD2-FORCED_MARCH_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, shuffle your Discard Pile into your Draw Pile and draw a card.
QUEENMOD2-FORCED_MARCH_POWER.smartDescri: At the start of your turn, shuffle your Discard Pile into your Draw Pile and draw {Amount} card{Amount:plural:|s}.
QUEENMOD2-SWARM_TACTICS_POWER.title: Swarm Tactics
QUEENMOD2-SWARM_TACTICS_POWER.descriptio: When you damage an enemy, apply 1 Swarm to it.
QUEENMOD2-SWARM_TACTICS_POWER.smartDescr: When you damage an enemy, apply 1 [gold]Swarm[/gold] to it.
QUEENMOD2-BUSY_POWER.title: Busy Bees
QUEENMOD2-BUSY_POWER.description: When you add a card to your Draw Pile, add an additional copy.
QUEENMOD2-BUSY_POWER.smartDescription: When you add a card to your Draw Pile, add an additional [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cop{Amount:plural:y|ies}
QUEENMOD2-PROTECT_QUEEN_POWER.title: Protect the Queen!
QUEENMOD2-PROTECT_QUEEN_POWER.descriptio: When you would take attack damage, play and Exhaust a Bumblebee draw pile.
QUEENMOD2-PROTECT_QUEEN_POWER.smartDescr: When you would take attack damage, play and Exhaust a Bumblebee from your draw pile that provides the best Block for the incoming damage.
QUEENMOD2-REINFORCEMENT_POWER.title: Reinforcements
QUEENMOD2-REINFORCEMENT_POWER.descriptio: At the start of the turn, add a Hornet or Bumblebee from your Draw Pile to your Hand. It costs 0 this turn.
